items.heading: Mansaf
details: Key ingredients: lamb, jameed (dried yogurt), rice, almonds
Rehydrate and simmer jameed dried yogurt into a tangy sauce.
Cook lamb in the yogurt sauce until tender.
Spread a bed of rice on a large platter.
Top with the lamb, pour over the sauce and scatter toasted almonds.

items.heading: Maqluba
details: Key ingredients: rice, eggplant, chicken, cauliflower, spices
Fry slices of eggplant and cauliflower until golden.
Layer the fried vegetables with chicken and rice in a pot.
Add spiced broth and simmer until the rice is cooked.
Flip the whole pot onto a platter to reveal the stacked layers.
